products.name: HireVue
products.note: Video interviewing AI; facial analysis controversy; algorithmic hiring bias; regulatory scrutiny

profile_text.body:
HireVue is a for-profit company founded in 2004 and headquartered in South Jordan, Utah. Its site describes it as a provider of AI-powered video interviewing, skills assessments, and candidate evaluation tools, with a particular focus on helping employers identify talent without in-person campus visits. The company positions its platform as a way to validate candidate skills and competencies at scale, including for early-career and graduate hiring.

HireVue's core product is its AI-driven hiring platform, which combines video interviewing with automated assessments. The product has attracted attention for its use of facial analysis in candidate evaluation and has faced scrutiny over concerns about algorithmic hiring bias and regulatory oversight.

The company is named in at least one federal lawsuit, Rodrigues v. HireVue, Inc., filed in the District Court for the Western District of Missouri, details of which are tracked in the site's litigation records.
